what_is_missing: the paper does not detail the exact transaction‑cost model beyond the rates used
no out‑of‑sample robustness checks beyond the post‑2010 test set are reported

source.title: Performance of Time-series Momentum Strategy: US

transposability.what_transfers: use of moving‑average based signals and linear regression framework can be applied to futures intraday data
what_does_not_transfer: the study is based on equity data (S&P500 constituents) not futures contracts
transaction‑cost rates are calibrated for equities and may differ for futures
the look‑back period of 24 days is a daily horizon, not directly comparable to intraday intervals
transposability.what_aligns_well: relative ranking of strategies by Sharpe ratio may remain informative for futures when adjusted for volatility
